verdict.rationale: Egnyte is a SaaS content platform, so offering a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The MCP connectivity and workflow webhooks it does describe are adjacent features and do not count as a downloadable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
